notes.content:
Very small patch, adding a QoL feature: Portals! 

Portals might appear starting from the 5th dungeon, they offer you a chance to skip a few rooms, so if you want to quickly get to the boss or farm an enemy found later in the dungeon, you can enter them and skip ahead.

Changelog

Adjustments:

 Added portals to dungeon exploration;

notes.content:
Just a tiny patch to address a very annoying bug regarding Quests. Thank you for all of the community members who reported it and helped me to fix it, now even old saves should work normally!

Changelog

Bugfixes
 Fixed a bug where opening the Quest menu without any Available Quests on the list would cause the game to crash;

Once again, thank you to each and every one of the players, especially to the ones who took their time to leave feedback and report bugs. I hope to have your continued support in the future so I can deliver the best game possible!

Cheers!
